title: Add built-in request validation middleware
description: Provides a declarative way to validate query, params, headers and body against JSON schemas before reaching route handlers, reducing boilerplate and preventing malformed requests from entering business logic. Integrates with existing error handling and logging to surface validation errors as standardized responses.
testCases: Validate that a request with a valid JSON body passes through to the route handler and receives a 200 response
Validate that a request with an invalid JSON body returns a 400 response with a detailed validation error payload
acceptance: When a route registers a schema, incoming requests are automatically validated; valid requests reach the handler unchanged, invalid requests are halted with a 400 Bad Request and a JSON error object containing the schema violation details. All existing tests remain green and coverage for the new middleware is >= 90%.
reason: Ensures data integrity at the edge of the application, cuts down on repetitive validation code, and improves security and reliability for production deployments.
